notes.title: Mini Motor Racing X - Hotfix v1.3.2
notes.notes:
Small update to address several issues:

* Fixed the pause menu not showing in Speedway, and the music not playing.
* Fixed several potential de-syncs in multiplayer.
* Corrected some unintentionally loud ambience on several tracks.
* The results screen is now interactable when playing in 2d mode with a gamepad.
* Fixed an issue that could cause players in 2D mode to become immovable objects in multiplayer.

notes.title: Party Pack Update!
notes.notes:
Huge new update adding four new game modes!

In Bombs Away, all players start in the center of the arena. A random player starts with the bomb, which brings with it enhanced speed. The player with the bomb can ram another player to pass the bomb onto them. Whoever has the bomb when the fuse runs down (and explodes) loses one health pip, and they start with a fresh bomb. Last one standing wins.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888386/0100ab2aae5004062fa7ee6d6e7507f0dcaae6ba.png

In King of the Road, all players once again start in the center of the arena, with a random player donning the crown—which earns you points while wearing it. Players must try to ram the crown holder to get the crown for themselves. Whoever has the most points when the time limit runs out wins.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888386/b30f02ed961af9a31ec4afa8b94991523fc2555a.png

Each player in Battle Arena starts with three health pips, and cars start spread out across the arena. Players pick up random weapons or items and attempt to attack the other players while avoiding their attacks. Last one standing wins.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888386/71bfe661b63b2adf2c37845aa97060d9e0078c42.png

Drop Zone mixes things up, with players starting spaced out around a floating platform. Players aim to knock each other off the edge of the platform—which shrinks over time, increasing the danger. Last one standing wins.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888386/b0c218460b034b8aea5a8bf353d7890ea71689a0.png

Full Update Notes:

* New Party Modes: Play with your friends online in a selection of wild party games -- each with their own unique tracks -- including Bumper Ball, Drop Zone, Battle Area, King of the Road and, Bomb's Away! 

* Added room codes to allow direct multiplayer joining with friends, across platforms.

* Improved new player experience.

* Combined Type X & Classic multiplayer pools for easier online matchmaking.

* Improved online UI experience, more game modes, more options!

* Performance and stability improvements.

* Various minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Mini Motor Racing X - Hotfix v1.0.4
notes.notes:
A small update to address some issues users were experiencing, including controller support. 


 Fixed the lobby intro sequence audio not being tied with the audio sliders in the options.
 Added a toggle to invert reverse direction in the options.
 Water detail is now automatically set to low when disabling anti-aliasing, this is to offset an issue with the shader.
 Fixed an issue where some controllers would appear as Index Controllers incorrectly.
 Added the ability to change the supported controller type in the options menu. This will allow users to troubleshoot if their controller has been detected incorrectly and not functioning.

notes.title: Mini Motor Racing X - Hotfix v1.0.3
notes.notes:

notes.title: Mini Motor Racing X - Hotfix v1.0.2
notes.notes:

notes.title: Mini Motor Racing X - Hotfix v1.0.1
notes.notes:
A small hotfix to address a critical issue some users were experiencing.


 Fixed an issue where in VR a user couldn't interact with the lobby screen, or game start key, when a non-vr controller was connected.
